digest.component_or_area: root modules and services (_mcp_models, _mcp_llm, _config_schema, review_bot, audit, metrics, attest, opcert_service, grounding)
propositions: Comment triage scope spans root src/rebar/*.py and attest/metrics/review_bot/opcert_service/audit/grounding/_guides with ~180 recoverable comment lines out of 7,248 (2.5%); scope is in good health with concentrated yield.

Schema drift defect in _mcp_models.BridgeFsckOut was already fixed on main; _mcp_models.py comment citing CI gate python -m rebar.schemas.check_mcp_models --check is now accurate and must be treated as DO_NOT_MOVE.
Machine-consumed markers in _config_schema.py (12 'read-via:' lines) and _mcp_llm.py FastMCP tool docstrings (~121 lines) are API surface or CI gates respectively and must not be removed.

_config_schema.py contains ~280 comment lines that are sole documentation for keys (completion_floor_active, comment_max_chars, auth_proxy_secret_env) absent from docs/config.md; recovery of more than ~34 lines requires writing docs/config.md rows first or destroys documentation.
Three ADRs (0067 bounded shutdown, 0068 in-flight counter, 0069 retryable deferral) document real current invariants in review_bot and must be cited from code rather than inlined.
All in-scope non-KEEP comment units were dispositioned into RELOCATE, DELETE, KEEP, DO_NOT_MOVE, or CORRECT-IN-PLACE; no behavior change and full test suite + lint + typecheck pass verified.
